data.long_meaning: Victorious, conqueror, successful. The name Najee carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. data.etymology: Najee belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”

in_english.name: Najee
in_english.meaning: Name that signifies gratitude and praise to Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Najee is an Islamic name that signifies gratitude and praise to Allah. It is derived from the Arabic root نَجَی which means to thank or praise Allah. In Islam, this name is used to signify obedience and devotion to Allah. It is recommended to use this name on special occasions such as birth or marriage. In some cases, it is used to express gratitude to Allah for His blessings. This name is associated with good character, kindness, and compassion.
